feedback.message: The account estimates timing but does not say whether the friend saw the collapse or found him afterward. Collapse time stays unknown until clarified.
feedback.suggestedQuestion: Did you see him collapse, or did you find him afterward? About what time?
feedback.spokenSummary: Collapse timing is unclear. Ask whether the friend saw the collapse.

feedback.message: A consumer wearable skin-temperature reading does not establish core body temperature. No clinical temperature measurement is linked to this statement.
feedback.suggestedQuestion: Has a clinical temperature been measured? If so, record the value, method or site, and time.
feedback.spokenSummary: Skin temperature is not core temperature. Record a clinical temperature with method and time.

feedback.message: Sweating does not exclude exertional heat stroke. Consider recording the skin finding without using it to rule heat illness in or out.
feedback.spokenSummary: Sweating does not rule out exertional heat stroke.

knowledgeReferences.title: National Athletic Trainers’ Association Position Statement: Exertional Heat Illnesses (Casa DJ et al., J Athl Train 2015;50(9):986–1000)
